statement: Source review for larger-cohort validation: frozen scale.rs and point-audit-v2 restrict seeds101/202; the future-only unadopted protocol still describes the same12targets. Curve::with_order_witness already validates prime field/order,nonsingularity,nonzero r-torsion generator and a unique Hasse multiple; its scalar multiplication does not reduce by advertised r. SEC1v2 section3.1.1.2.1 and Sutherland18.783Fall2025Lecture7 provide existing domain/order validation and Hasse unique-multiple methods; Std Nat.eq_of_dvd_of_lt_two_mul is available. An independent replay would be validation of existing methods, not a new mechanism or a claim that the constructor lacks them. No new admission/solver experiment has run.
